definitions.gloss: to change clothes; to get changed
definitions.explanation: To take off current clothes and put on different ones.

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}をかいたので{着替|きが}えたい。
examples.english: I'm sweaty so I want to change clothes.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}から{帰|かえ}ったら、すぐに{楽|らく}な{服|ふく}に{着替|きが}える。
examples.english: When I get home from work, I immediately change into comfortable clothes.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{着替|きが}えさせてから{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I got the child changed before going out.

examples.japanese: {制服|せいふく}に{着替|きが}えてから{学校|がっこう}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I change into my uniform before going to school.

examples.japanese: {更衣室|こういしつ}で{着替|きが}えて、プールに{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I changed in the locker room and got in the pool.

notes:
{着替|きが}える is both transitive and intransitive. It can mean "to change one's own clothes" (intransitive use) or "to change [specific clothing]" (transitive use).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{着替|きが}えている typically indicates an ongoing action of changing clothes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {服|ふく}に{着替|きが}える - to change into clothes
- {着替|きが}えさせる - to change someone's clothes (causative)
- {着替|きが}え - change of clothes (noun form)

PARTICLE USAGE:
- [clothing]に{着替|きが}える - to change into [clothing]
- [clothing]を{着替|きが}える - to change [specific clothing item]

RELATED WORDS:
- {着替|きが}え - spare clothes, change of clothes
- {更衣室|こういしつ} - changing room, locker room

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {着替|きが}えていませんでした
